g.text: $ nasync --help
Usage: nasync [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...
NASync — sync your local folders to a SAMBA home NAS, with class.
Options:
--version Show the version and exit.
--help Show this message and exit.
Commands:
add Add a sync pair to the active server (or --server)
auto Run automatic syncing in the foreground (live and/or...
credentials Show how saved passwords are protected, or discard them
duplicates Find files that appear more than once on the server
encryption Show or set SMB 3 encryption for a server
gui Launch the desktop app (GTK4 + libadwaita)
init Initialize SAMBA server configuration
install-desktop Add a desktop launcher + icon to your app menu (Linux)
list List sync pairs for the active server (each server has...
live-sync Turn live sync on or off (sync moments after a file...
ls List a directory on the server
mode Show or set the sync mode used by sync, watch, and auto
notifications Turn desktop notifications for automatic syncs on or off
remove Remove a sync pair from the active server (or --server)
restore Restore local directories from server backup
scheduled-sync Turn the daily scheduled sync on or off, and set its time
server-info Show what this server is and what was negotiated with it
servers List saved servers (the active one is marked *)
service Turn background syncing on or off, or inspect it
setup Guided first-time setup: server, share, and sync pairs...
status Show sync configuration status
sync Sync local directories to the server (incremental)
test-connection Check server connectivity, credentials, and share access
usage Show what is using space on the server
use Switch the active server
watch Watch local directories and sync on changes (one-off...
